name: srijon-claude-plugins
description: Claude Code plugins by Md. Rahat Islam.

plugins.name: claudio-notify
plugins.description: Audio notifications for Claude Code: distinct, customizable sounds when tasks finish, subagents start or stop, Claude asks a question, needs permission, or you near a usage limit — per model.

plugins.name: pace-maker
plugins.description: A per-conversation progress band for Claude Code: two rows above the prompt with task progress, what Claude is doing now, and why it stopped, at zero model tokens by default.
